title: cyperus giolii var. nogalensis
intro: Cyperus giolii var. nogalensis, commonly known as Nogales flatsedge, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate conditions such as fever, arthritis, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. Research suggests that the bioactive compounds present in Cyperus giolii var. nogalensis may also possess anti-cancer and neuroprotective activities, although more studies are needed to confirm these findings.
